title: C¹ step function ψ_ε for the truncations h_t = ψ(h − t)
statement: For every ε > 0 there is a function ψ : ℝ → ℝ of class C¹ such that 0 ≤ ψ ≤ 1, ψ(x) = 0 for x ≤ 0, ψ(x) = 1 for x ≥ ε, ψ'(x) ≥ 0 for all x, ψ' is bounded above by some real M, and for every a ∈ ℝ the Lebesgue (lower) integral ∫_{(0,∞)} ψ'(a − t) dt (of the [0, ∞]-valued function ENNReal.ofReal(ψ'(a − t))) is at most 1.
lean_statement: ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x ∧ ψ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x, x ≤ 0 → ψ x = 0) ∧ (∀ x, ε ≤ x → ψ x = 1) ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ deriv ψ x) ∧ (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ x, deriv ψ x ≤ M) ∧ ∀ a : ℝ, ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (deriv ψ (a - t)) ≤ 1
